Values adapted in part from "Infrared spectroscopy correlation table", Wikipedia, CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Infrared_spectroscopy_correlation_table). Values cross-checked against OpenStax Organic Chemistry, section 12.7, Table 12.1 (values only; no text copied) (https://openstax.org/books/organic-chemistry/pages/12-7-interpreting-infrared-spectra).
